title: Breaking the Filter Bubble: A Semantic Pareto-DQN Framework for Multi-Objective Recommendation
reasoning: The paper explicitly centers on 'Responsible AI' and 'AI Alignment' by integrating societal values such as 'provider fairness' and 'information diversity' into a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework. It evaluates the trade-offs (the 'Price of Responsibility') between engagement and these ethical/societal objectives, moving beyond a simple mention of ethical considerations to making them a core component of the benchmarking and methodology.
